system.description: You share an affinity with another Cainite (most likely, but not necessarily, a Toreador) that arose without a Blood Oath or other artifice. You would lay down your unlife for each other and feel empty apart. A 3-point Merit lets you occasionally sense your "twin's" strong emotions when nearby; a 5-point Merit lets you often sense those emotions even at a distance, including physical pain or peril.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
